name: The PaperHands Arena
description: A three-round browser survival game. In practice, solve circuit puzzles that NEAR AI Cloud can generate, predict the crowd in a train game, or flee and give up part of your play stake. A NEAR Testnet vault implements the original Hold/Flee rules.
problem: Social survival games often give players no meaningful choice when they walk away. This arena makes each exit change the other players' positions through a fixed, verifiable redistribution rule.
userFlow: Run npm ci --omit=dev and npm run dev with Node.js 22. Open the local URL to see the practice lobby.
With Fast-forward enabled, click Enter. Solve the circuit clues, toggle switches, and lock in to reveal the answer.
Choose a train, reveal where the other players boarded, and continue to the final circuit. Flee before locking in to preview the tax.
Run npm run test:arena to check conservation, round deadlines, and payout behavior.
